scatter_plot.caption: Strong linear trend — y rises steadily with x.
Curved relationship — a parabola the eye catches at once.
No correlation — the cloud is round and directionless.
Outlier-driven — three stray points dominate the picture.

line_plot.caption: Upward trend — throughput climbs steadily over the period.
Seasonal cycle — a repeating wave rides on the noise.
Flat series — no trend, only point-to-point variation.
Step change — the level drops abruptly midway through.

correlation_heatmap.caption: Strong blocks — high positive and negative correlations stand out.
Weak correlations — no meaningful structure between variables.
Mixed signs — positive and negative associations side by side.
One dominant pair — a single strong link among independents.

bubble_plot.caption: Size tracks x — larger bubbles cluster to the right.
Unrelated size — bubble area carries no signal.
Colour gradient — a fourth variable encoded as colour.
Few large players — a handful of bubbles dominate the field.

hexbin_plot.caption: Correlated mass — density stretches along the diagonal.
Two clusters — the bins reveal two distinct groups.
Uniform spread — no concentration anywhere in the plane.
Skewed density — mass piles up near the origin.

regression_plot.caption: Linear fit — the degree-1 line tracks the data well.
Curved trend — degree 2 follows the acceleration.
Weak slope — the fit is nearly flat against the noise.
Outliers pull — a few points bend the fitted line.

density_contour.caption: Correlated mass — density stretches along the diagonal.
Two clusters — the bins reveal two distinct groups.
Uniform spread — no concentration anywhere in the plane.
Skewed density — mass piles up near the origin.

grouped_bar.caption: Shifted levels — group means differ clearly.
No group effect — all categories average the same.
One dominant group — totals driven by category A.
Mixed signs — some groups average below zero.

box_by_category.caption: Shifted levels — group means differ clearly.
No group effect — all categories average the same.
One dominant group — totals driven by category A.
Mixed signs — some groups average below zero.

violin_by_category.caption: Location shifts — violins sit at different heights.
Bimodal group — category A shows two humps.
Right-skewed — long upper tails in every group.
Growing spread — violins widen from A to C.

crosstab_heatmap.caption: Independent factors — shares spread evenly across cells.
Strong association — each region favours a different outcome.
Row-normalised — rates comparable despite unequal group sizes.
Rare combinations — some cells barely occur at all.

binned_mean_plot.caption: Linear trend — binned means climb steadily.
Nonlinear wave — binning reveals a sinusoid under the noise.
No relationship — the binned means stay flat.
Stable mean, growing noise — trend holds while spread widens.

errorbar_plot.caption: Constant uncertainty — every estimate is equally precise.
Growing uncertainty — later measurements are noisier.
Two-dimensional error — both x and y carry uncertainty.
Small samples — wide intervals warn against over-reading.

area_between.caption: Constant band — a fixed tolerance around the nominal curve.
Widening band — uncertainty grows away from the origin.
Confidence envelope — interval balloons at the edges.
Seasonal envelope — the band breathes with the cycle.

step_plot.caption: Random walk steps — level drifts up in discrete jumps.
Setpoint changes — the target holds between adjustments.
Countdown — a quantity decrements to zero.
Depletion — inventory falls in discrete withdrawals.

joint_scatter_hist.caption: Correlated pair — marginals are both bell-shaped.
Independent normals — no joint or marginal surprises.
Skewed marginals — both histograms lean right.
Bimodal y — the side histogram exposes two groups.

bivariate_histogram.caption: Correlated mass — density stretches along the diagonal.
Two clusters — the bins reveal two distinct groups.
Uniform spread — no concentration anywhere in the plane.
Skewed density — mass piles up near the origin.

outlier_scatter.caption: IQR fences — three points fall outside the whiskers.
Z-score rule — extreme standardised values flagged.
Tight fence — a strict threshold flags borderline points.
Clean data — nothing exceeds the fences.

residual_relationship.caption: Adequate fit — residuals scatter randomly around zero.
Missed curvature — residuals arc because the fit is too simple.
Heteroscedasticity — the residual spread fans out with x.
Influential outlier — one point dominates the residual scale.

quantile_bin_plot.caption: Linear rise — each decile of x adds the same amount.
Diminishing returns — the curve flattens at high x.
No effect — every quantile bin averages the same.
Median robustness — the median ignores the injected outliers.

bland_altman.caption: Good agreement — differences hug zero inside narrow limits.
Constant bias — method B reads six units high throughout.
Proportional bias — the gap widens as magnitude grows.
Poor agreement — wide limits of agreement reject interchangeability.

rank_scatter.caption: Monotone linear — ranks fall neatly along the diagonal.
Monotone but curved — ranking straightens the square-root shape.
U-shaped — ranks reveal the reversal of direction.

lag_plot.caption: White noise — no structure, consecutive values independent.
Autocorrelated — the diagonal band shows lag-1 dependence.
Seasonal series — lag 12 exposes the repeating cycle.
Trending series — the tight diagonal reflects the drift.

conditional_box.caption: Linear shift — box medians march upward across bins.
Nonlinear — medians rise then fall with x.
Widening spread — boxes grow taller toward high x.
No relationship — every bin looks the same.
